Five CRPF Personnel Injured in Jammu-Srinagar Highway Accident

An accident occurred on the Jammu-Srinagar National Highway in Qazigund's Levdora area when a CRPF vehicle collided with a truck. At least five Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) personnel sustained injuries in the incident. The CRPF vehicle overturned following the collision. The injured personnel were subsequently shifted to a hospital.
